title: imp.ext carries gpid/tid; regs carries 2.6 gpp/gpp_sid — both recognized, neither flagged

source.name: IAB OpenRTB 2.6 — Object: Regs (gpp/gpp_sid, §3.2.3); imp.ext.gpid/imp.ext.tid are widely-adopted IAB-adjacent extension conventions Core already allowlists (packages/core/rules/dialects-questions), not 2.6.md root fields
source.notes: gpp/gpp_sid values are synthetic placeholders with no real-world consent semantics decoded or claimed; no TCF/GPP decoding is performed or asserted (see docs/USER_GUIDE.md — GPP decoding is out of scope for this product).

modifications: All auction, bid, creative, site, app and publisher identifiers are synthetic.
All domains use reserved .test names; no real user IDs, IP addresses, consent strings or tracker endpoints.
All text and SVG artwork are original; no public creative copied.
device.ip is the documentation-only address 192.0.2.11; OS values describe a synthetic test device.
regs.gpp is a short synthetic placeholder string, not a captured real consent string.
provenance.sanitized: Only synthetic identifiers, original fixture creatives, reserved domains and TEST-NET addresses. No live tokens, subscriber IDs or real tracking URLs.

pairApplicability.note: Every response bid references an offered impression; auction identifiers match.

specNotes: Protocol validity is based on cited fields, not on current Core output. Optional-field warnings do not make this pair invalid.

imp.ext.gpid and imp.ext.tid are both members of Core's own imp[].ext allowlist (rules/dialects-questions: {skadn,gpid,dpid,is_secure,tid,data,reward,dlp,omidpn,omidpv}) — they are expected to be silently accepted, not raised as dialects.question.unknown_ext_signal.

regs.gpp and regs.gpp_sid are supplied together (both non-empty) specifically to avoid the two paired advisories (regs.gpp_sid_without_string / regs.gpp_string_without_sid) that fire when only one of the pair is present.

regs.gpp/gpp_sid are each independently a listed 2.6 request signal (packages/core/detect.js SIGNALS_2_6); this pins the request to 2.6 at confidence 1 even though nothing else in the payload is version-specific.
This product does not decode GPP/TCF consent strings (docs/USER_GUIDE.md) — no claim is made about the string's internal validity, only that its presence alongside gpp_sid is accepted cleanly.
Browser assertions are proposed observables; this corpus has not been run in a browser.
HTML and original embedded SVG need no external resources. Assert the fixture label is visible, image.complete and naturalWidth > 0, and expected creative dimensions.
No scripts, trackers, navigation handlers, external font/CDN URLs or live network fetches are present in the banner markup.
notes: Core observations in the source archive were deliberately excluded from expectations. Protocol metadata may describe a vendor-specific 2.x carrier; it does not claim a normative minor-version inference.
